# Distributions, and untying the cholesky/LKJ knot {#sec-distributions}

- Fix the distribution-level bugs and finally untangle the
  cholesky/LKJ representation issues that have run since 2017. Grouping
  labels: the `distributions` cluster (which overlaps
  greta.distributions). The full history is collated in
  @sec-cholesky - read it before touching this code.
- These issues share machinery: the wishart/LKJ log-probs, the
  representations (cholesky-factor) system, and how initial values are
  set on distributions returned via an operation node.

**The through-line.** [#339](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/339)
named the debt in 2020: wishart/LKJ return "an operation node
following a distribution... a bit hacky", which is why users cannot
set initial values on them ([#440](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/440),
[#502](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/502)). The sketched fix is a `transformed_variable` node
([#339](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/339)) plus the working prior-sampling prototype in
[#584](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/584). Code anchors:
`R/probability_distributions.R` (wishart/LKJ log-probs and the [#737](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/737)
note), `R/node_class.R` (sampling-mode representation surgery),
`R/tf_functions.R` (`CorrelationCholesky`, `FillScaleTriL`).

**[#692](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/692) is not in this milestone, and that is deliberate.** Which
triangle greta's cholesky factor uses is squarely a distributions
question, and the fix will touch the same representation machinery as
everything above. But it is a **breaking change**, and the plan batches
it with the other known breaking change,
[#648](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/648), so that users
migrate once rather than twice. Its write-up therefore sits in
milestone 8 (@sec-printing). Expect to do the work with this milestone
and release it with that one - and read its block before touching
`chol()`, because the July 2026 pass recorded it as already fixed and
was wrong.

## The cholesky/LKJ history {#sec-cholesky}

Collated from every cholesky-related issue, closed and open (July
2026). The short version: correlation/covariance variables are
modelled via their cholesky factors under the hood; a
"representations" system was built so downstream operations could
reuse those factors; the TF2 port broke it; the 0.5.0 fixes restored
correctness at the cost of the fast path; two bugs and one diagnosis
remain open.

**The arc:**

- **Founding intent** (2017-18):
  [#77](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/77) added LKJ ("oh
  shit. this ain't easy." - from the thread);
  [#86](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/86) founded the
  representations system (skip re-factorisation by propagating
  cholesky factors);
  [#107](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/107) and
  [#281](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/281) contain
  the clearest explanations of the design and
  `chol_to_symmetric`.
- **The acknowledged debt** (2020):
  [#339](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/339) - wishart/LKJ
  return "an operation node following a distribution... a bit hacky",
  which is why users cannot set initial values on them
  ([#440](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/440),
  [#502](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/502)). Proposed
  fix: a `transformed_variable` node with bijector-based reversal.
- **TF2 breakage** (2022-24):
  [#560](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/560)
  (`input_output_cholesky` must be FALSE for sampling, TRUE for
  log-prob); [#585](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/585)
  ("cholesky factors all out of whack in calculate" - the
  ones-matrix and post-MCMC overwrite);
  [#593](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/593) (the most
  detailed debugging thread: the `$representation`-vs-`$representations` typo,
  tf-name collisions, and the unresolved design note that
  "everything that is a representation of something else needs to
  know what it is a representation of... this could be infinitely
  recursive").
- **The cost of correctness** (2024): PR
  [#637](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/pull/637) removed the
  representations fast path to get correct answers;
  [#642](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/642) benchmarks
  the cost - `calculate(chol(Sigma))` on a 3000×3000 wishart went
  from ~56 ms to ~13 s (~250×).
- **The bias fixes** (Nov 2024, greta 0.5.0):
  [#729](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/729)
  (`FillTriangular` → `FillScaleTriL`), then PR
  [#734](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/pull/734) added the
  missing `CholeskyOuterProduct` log-det-Jacobian adjustment to
  wishart and LKJ log-probs and the Geweke tests that verify them.
  [#737](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/737) was born
  here: greta's LKJ normalising constant disagrees with the
  test-helper reference; density-exactness tests were disabled
  rather than diagnosed.

**Still open:**
[#440](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/440) (initials -
the sketched fix is
[#339](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/339)'s
`transformed_variable` plus the complete prior-sampling
prototype in
[#584](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/584): "this
shouldn't be a helper function, it should be how greta initialises
values by default");
[#737](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/737) (normalising
constant, undiagnosed);
[#589](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/589) (chol of a
computed covariance fails - noting the reprex's matrix is not
actually guaranteed positive-definite, so the right fix may be a
graceful error);
[#347](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/347) (possibly fixed
by 0.5.0, never re-verified); and a June 2025 recurrence report on
[#732](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/732).
[#692](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/692) (the
lower/upper-triangular convention) **is now closed**: 0.6.0 already
returns an upper factor matching `base::chol()`. Treat the orientation
as settled when reading the threads below - several predate the fix and
discuss it as an open choice.

**Read-first shortlist for a fixer:** the
[#593](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/593) thread; the
[#585](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/585) symptom
taxonomy; PR [#734](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/pull/734)'s
commits (especially the CholeskyOuterProduct adjustment);
[#560](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/560)'s
`input_output_cholesky` rule;
[#642](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/642)'s benchmark;
and [#339](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/339) +
[#584](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/584) as the design
for the initials fix. Code anchors:
`R/probability_distributions.R` (wishart/LKJ log-probs and the
[#737](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/737) note),
`R/node_class.R` (sampling-mode representation surgery),
`R/tf_functions.R` (`CorrelationCholesky`, `FillScaleTriL`).


## [Issue #159](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/159)

- 2018-05-03
- (none)
- The wishart error for insufficient degrees of freedom is unclear.
- problem: cryptic failure when df < dimension.
- finding: a validation gap in the wishart constructor.
- fix: check df up front; clear error. Batches with [#646](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/646).
- priority: medium.

## [Issue #339](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/339)

- 2020-01-28
- documentation

## [Issue #440](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/440)

- 2021-09-25
- (none)
- `initial_values` fail with LKJ priors.
- problem: LKJ is returned via an operation node, so initials can't attach ([#339](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/339)).
- finding: the [#339](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/339) + [#584](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/584) route is the sketched fix.
- fix: land `transformed_variable` so initials attach to the underlying variable.
- priority: high.

## [Issue #584](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/584)

- 2023-02-27
- Up Next
- A helper to provide better initial values.
- finding: the prototype argues initials-from-priors "should be how greta initialises values by default", not a helper.
- fix: adopt prior-sampling as the default init; generalises [#413](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/413).
- priority: high (pairs with [#440](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/440)/#339).

## [Issue #589](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/589)

- 2023-10-18
- (none)

## [Issue #737](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/issues/737)

- 2024-11-01
- (none)
- Add a reference implementation of the LKJ normalising constant.
- problem: greta's LKJ normalising constant disagrees with the test reference; exactness tests were disabled, not diagnosed.
- finding: the discrepancy lives in the LKJ log-prob in `R/probability_distributions.R`.
- fix: derive the reference; reconcile; re-enable the disabled tests.
- priority: high (correctness).
